Signed bundle staging and refusal outcomes record counts in logs/feature-evidence.jsonl; promotion requires paired-machine proof and zero unsafe install.

Watch-only on every machine: one row per admit (held = would deny). Bars are its spec FD12: 100+ admits, would-deny under 1%, no errored admits or shed work. Enforce flips one class at a time (FD8), so the first class split out gets its own entry.

BenchmarkDivergenceAnalyzer records one row per pass: fired when comparable, held when the benchmark mirror is stale or coverage is incomplete (the reason says which), error when a pass fails. Rows appear only while the benchmark-divergence-analysis job runs.

Its log holds the 2966-row soak that ended 10-01 with no verdict; 99% of jobs declared no effects. Both model families said redesign: require declared effects, check them in code, drop the third-party call. That change comes before any rung. Grade through POST /maturation/evidence.
DynamicMcpService records fired per applied load or offload and error per restart-failed or aborted change. The 11-05 review: one real cycle with durable results on a test session, or retire it.
Runs only on the operated feedback host and feeds the drain, so it has no fleet of its own and moves with the drain, whose readiness metrics carry the evidence.

CollaborationRedriveEngine records fired per nudge handed to the relay, held at most daily per reason when a cap or guard stops one, error per failed send. It has no dry-run and messages peers, so its first live run is the proof; the review grades whether each nudge was right.

Observe-only: each finding goes to its own log and never touches the message. Its question is how often the regex cries wolf, so the review grades findings through POST /maturation/evidence. A louder version is a separate decision.

Bars are spec D9: 10+ real messages with zero wrong would-blocks. The operator adjudicates every block and that goes in as an outcome row; the flip to enforcing stays the operator's. Canary rows also match the count, so read the log before trusting a near-threshold number.
Every review decision is a line in logs/promise-review.jsonl (outcome applied / would-apply / refused / capped; action reopen for an undo).

Slice 0 ships only the repairs (canonical skill backfill, per-machine telemetry hook). From slice 1 the sentinel writes content-free rows to logs/skill-learning.jsonl: kind would-create (shadow) or create (live) shows it ran; regression and revert rows are the harm. The dev rung flips mode to live after the shadow sample; the fleet step is the operator's after the rung-1 sample (spec section 7).
